title: Day 790: Unidentified Man Found Dead Beside Humaya Canal North of Culiacán
detail: At approximately 10:30 AM on Monday, September 21, 2026, residents reported a body on a dirt road beside the Humaya Canal, near the Culiacán Diocesan Seminary and the Alto de Coyote community, north of Culiacán. Responding authorities found an unidentified man wearing a black Lacoste shirt and black pants showing evident signs of violence. The State Fiscalía opened an investigation and ordered a forensic autopsy to determine the exact cause of death and establish his identity; no suspects had been named as of the report.
confidenceReason: Only a single Tier-2 outlet had reported this discovery at time of writing; victim identity and cause of death remain unconfirmed by the Fiscalía.
